name: Flower
description: Web-based monitoring and administration tool for Celery distributed task queues.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      CELERY_BROKER_URL: "redis://{{serviceName}}-redis:6379/0"
      FLOWER_BASIC_AUTH: {{env.FLOWER_BASIC_AUTH}}
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
